## Problem and resulting behavior

Describe the concrete trigger and what this change improves.

## Scope

- [ ] Shared improvement, usable across games
- [ ] Game/version-specific logic under `GameName_PAL` or a separate region folder

## Evidence and validation

List the relevant tool tests and any required local full game builds. Keep game
data, proprietary tools, claims, drafts and private verification logs out of the PR.

## Remaining limits

State unsupported contexts and any independent review still required.
